bio: Run by Sandy and Christian Heß, this is an appealing restaurant – and that goes for the atmosphere as well as the cuisine. The interior is sleek, bright and welcoming, with beautiful arched windows affording a view of the Neckar River. And then there's the terrace overlooking the water – a truly idyllic spot in which to dine in fine weather! The cuisine is contemporary with a Mediterranean touch – opt for a set menu or order à la carte. This lovely space can also be used for private functions....
